title: Backshift: put in the verb
instructions: Mila is an exchange student from Germany. She spends a year with the Moreno family and goes to Lakeview High School. Report what people said. Write the **verb form** in the gap.

items.text: Sofia said that she {{liked}} horror films.

items.direct: Diego: "I am working on my bike."
items.text: Diego said that he {{was working}} on his bike.

items.direct: Mila: "I have lost my locker key."
items.text: Mila said that she {{had lost}} her locker key.

items.direct: Tyler: "I missed the bus this morning."
items.text: Tyler said that he {{had missed}} the bus that morning.

items.direct: Aisha: "I will help you with your project."
items.text: Aisha told Mila that she {{would help}} her with her project.

items.direct: Mr Okafor: "The new timetable is ready."
items.text: Mr Okafor said that the new timetable {{was}} ready.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno: "We are going to visit my sister."
items.text: Mrs Moreno said that they {{were going to visit}} her sister.

items.direct: Mila: "My parents have never been to the USA."
items.text: Mila said that her parents {{had never been}} to the USA.
items.hint: present perfect → past perfect. *never* stays between *had* and *been*.

items.text: Diego said that their team {{had won}} the game.
Tyler said that he {{didn't understand}} the homework.
